name: three-d-carousel
blurb: 3D cylindrical carousel with perspective transforms and modal image expansion.
description: Displays images in a 3D cylindrical formation that rotates on interaction. Clicking an image expands it in a modal overlay. Uses Framer Motion transforms and perspective calculations for 3D effect. Responsive to screen size.
use_when: Showcasing a gallery of images with an immersive, eye-catching 3D presentation.
avoid_when: Performance-critical contexts—3D transforms and blur effects demand GPU acceleration.
a11y: Images clickable to open modal; no keyboard navigation or ARIA labels. Modal closes on click. No prefers-reduced-motion guard.
